steps.text: Plantain (100/130 g) in 1.5 cm DICE, not slices. This is a hash.
Wide pan, oil (6/7 g, rapeseed), medium-high. Plantain in a single layer, 4 minutes without touching it, then turned and 3 minutes more until the faces are dark.
Onion (40/50 g) and pepper (80/100 g) in, 4 minutes.
Tomato (80/100 g), thyme, scotch bonnet and a pinch of stock powder. 3 minutes, until it clings to everything rather than sitting in the pan.
Push the hash into two heaps, clear a space, and fry the eggs (125/150 g — 2½ / 3) alongside on a hard heat so the whites frill and brown at the edge.

why: Single layer, and don't touch it. Plantain browns by contact, and a crowded pan steams it into something sweet and wet instead of caramelising it at the corners.
notes: D0-003: oil is a hot-pan frying use only — whole row renames olive_oil -> rapeseed_oil (6/7 g, unchanged grams).

Single wide-pan flow, genuinely sequential — no parallel tracks needed. Total ~18 min against the card's 14-minute chip; the difference is honest (dicing/fold/plating time not itemised in the original prose), not padding.
